To share your theme with everyone:

1. Export it as a .zip (button below).
2. On the site, Themes → Submit a theme page: create your theme, then click 📦 Studio ZIP and choose the ZIP. The theme.css, the meta.json, the project (studio.json) and all the files are filled in at once. Add a preview image.
3. Once approved, it shows up in the app's library and on Discord. Those who download it can reopen it in their Studio (File → Edit a Studio theme).
